decision.reason: all three criteria hold, so the log-shrunk form is selected

rule.criterion_A: the support-weighted role-cell RMSE improves by more than one standard error of the paired per-fold difference, i.e. mean(R1 - R0) < -1.0 * se(R1 - R0) with a finite positive se
rule.criterion_B: no supported role cell worsens by more than 0.5 in rms z, where a cell's deterioration is the mean over folds of (rms z of R1 - rms z of R0)
rule.criterion_C: pooled neutrality, same-player preservation and PSD all hold for both arms in every fold
rule.holdout_role: none; 2024 and 2025 are excluded from every frame this file touches
rule.primary_objective: support-weighted RMSE over supported cells: sqrt(sum_c pairs_c * rmse_c^2 / sum_c pairs_c)
rule.secondary_objective_reported_not_decisiv: equal-weighted RMSE over supported cells: sqrt(mean_c rmse_c^2), the convention the stored inner selection used
rule.statement: select R1 only if all three criteria hold on the pre-2024 forward folds of the primary universe; otherwise select R0

title: final role-scale ablation: R0 ratio against R1 log-shrunk
